class.name: DifferentialData
class.brief_description: Configuration for a driven axle's wheel differential.
class.description: DifferentialData selects an [code]OPEN[/code], [code]LIMITED_SLIP[/code], or [code]LOCKED[/code] policy for relative motion between an axle's two wheel bodies. The axle's positive [member Axle.drive_share] is a separate value: direct [code]RotationalNetwork[/code] setup copies each policy into [code]DifferentialSettings[/code] and normalizes positive shares across one through eight driven axles as flat weights, with no inter-axle differential. At each solve the carrier velocity is computed directly from predicted left/right wheel velocities. In [code]OPEN[/code] mode no relative row is constructed; [code]LOCKED[/code] mode constructs a transient row with unbounded capacity. In [code]LIMITED_SLIP[/code], lock capacity is [code]min(max_lock_torque, preload_torque + active_lock_ratio * abs(transmitted_torque) + slip_sensitive_gain * abs(relative_slip))[/code]. The active ratio is [member power_lock_ratio] when transmitted torque times carrier velocity is non-negative (power) and [member coast_lock_ratio] otherwise (coast). Settings are copied into fixed setup storage; runtime solving performs no dynamic allocation.

method.name: set_mode
method.description: Sets the differential mode: Open, Limited Slip, or Locked.

method.name: set_preload_torque
method.description: Sets the baseline limited-slip locking torque. Default: 25 Nm.

method.name: get_preload_torque
method.description: Returns the baseline limited-slip locking torque (default 25 Nm).

method.name: set_power_lock_ratio
method.description: Sets the limited-slip lock ratio used for positive transmitted power. Default: 0.35.

method.name: get_power_lock_ratio
method.description: Returns the positive-power limited-slip lock ratio (default 0.35).

method.name: set_coast_lock_ratio
method.description: Sets the limited-slip lock ratio used during coast or engine braking. Default: 0.15.

method.name: get_coast_lock_ratio
method.description: Returns the coast limited-slip lock ratio (default 0.15).

method.name: set_slip_sensitive_gain
method.description: Sets the bounded lock-capacity gain per rad/s of relative speed. Default: 2 Nm per rad/s.

method.name: get_slip_sensitive_gain
method.description: Returns the relative-speed lock-capacity gain (default 2 Nm per rad/s).

method.name: set_max_lock_torque
method.description: Sets the maximum limited-slip locking torque cap. Default: 250 Nm.

method.name: get_max_lock_torque
method.description: Returns the maximum limited-slip locking torque cap (default 250 Nm).

members.member: Baseline limited-slip locking torque in Nm. Inactive for Open and Locked modes.
Lock ratio when transmitted torque times carrier velocity is non-negative. Inactive for Open and Locked modes.
Lock ratio when transmitted torque times carrier velocity is negative. Inactive for Open and Locked modes.
Lock-capacity gain in Nm per rad/s of relative speed. Inactive for Open and Locked modes.
Maximum limited-slip lock capacity in Nm. Inactive for Open and Locked modes.
